text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: There are lots of special days in life.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Birthdays, Shichi-Go-San, wedding

anniversaries... All are worth celebrating,
but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Today is more wonderful than all of
them put
together!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day I get to race Dia in a
G1 race!
Today is the day we've been
working toward
forever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And entering the scene to the roar of
the crowd,
voted the most popular
Umamusume by the fans,
Kitasan Black!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
I don't think there's ever been an
Umamusume as
beloved as her! Just look
at all those huge flags
being waved
around the paddock in support!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And now, making her own dazzling
entrance, it's
the second-most popular
Umamusume, Satono
Diamond!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She was born into wealth and has been
in the
spotlight since before her debut!
Surely this
gorgeous diamond will shine
on the track today!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What dramatic twists and turns are in
store for us
today as these two lifelong
friends go
head-to-head?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Twists and turns? There won't be
anything like
what they're expecting,
even if there are any...
We only got this
far because we had each other.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. I'm just glad that we received so
many
votes from the fans.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I think the number of people who voted
for me
went up a little, but I only got
first by a narrow
margin.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I trailed behind you very
slightly, but
that's how things always
have been, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's almost scary how fast you caught up
to me!
Still...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to let you surpass me,
either in the
polls or the race! I'm
crossing the finish line first,
Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to accept the status quo.
It's time
for me to shake things up.
Today's the day I
overtake you and beat
you to the finish!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this festival one for the ages,

together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! At long last, our dream is about to
turn into
reality!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
But that's not all! This Arima Kinen isn't
just about
between these two.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Everything really had to fall into place
for this
last-second entrant! Will this
super Umamusume
be able to pull off
another miracle?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Teio... I can't wait to race with you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll admit, I was really surprised when I
found out
you were running today too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Kita, I stand here before you as your
opponent
today.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
My opponent?! That can't be... I've
looked up to
you for so long. You're my
idol!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Come on, is that any way for a Triple
Crown
champion to talk?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I want to beat you fair and square, not
just with
statistics and numbers, but with
my own two legs.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So? What do you two think? Is there
room for one
more in your dream race?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Of course! Today's the day I pay
you back
for the dream you've given me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To Kitasan Black, this lineup has to feel
like the
culmination of all her hard work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her idol and her eternal best friend
on the
track with her, Kitasan Black's
unforgettable
dream race gets
underway!
